faq.q: Do I need my own agent to attend a Chilliwack open house?
faq.a: No official source requires it. Rule 5-10(3) of the Real Estate Rules excuses disclosure of representation where a licensee is only hosting an advertised open house or answering general factual questions — but the moment you share your motivation, financial qualifications or needs, that changes, and BCFSA requires unrepresented consumers to be told the risks of dealing with a licensee who represents the other party.

faq.q: Which Chilliwack areas can I cover in one trip?
faq.a: Group by the City's own OCP neighbourhood plan areas — Chilliwack Proper and Fairfield Island, Downtown, Eastern Hillsides, Sardis, South Vedder and Yarrow; Sardis-side areas (Sardis, Garrison Crossing, Promontory, Vedder) cluster south of Highway 1 and Chilliwack Proper clusters north of it.

faq.q: If I buy after an open house in Chilliwack, when are property taxes due?
faq.a: The City mails tax notices at the end of May and taxes are due the first working day after July 1 each year; for 2026 the City published a 5% penalty for taxes outstanding after July 2, 2026 and an additional 5% after August 4, 2026, and your lawyer or notary allocates the bill between buyer and seller on the Statement of Adjustments.

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in Chilliwack Open?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.
